{% extends "!base.html" %} {# Announcement bar marking work-in-progress docs. The theme gates its whole
on `{% if self.announce() %}` (sphinx_immaterial/base.html), so this block MUST render to the empty string on a tagged build — whitespace alone is truthy in Jinja and would paint an empty banner across every released page. Hence the `{%- -%}` trimming throughout. `otto_dev_banner_text` / `otto_stable_docs_url` come from html_context in conf.py; the text is None on a release build. See scripts/docs_build_stamp.py. #} {%- block announce -%} {%- if otto_dev_banner_text -%} {{ otto_dev_banner_text }} For the latest release, see the stable documentation. {%- endif -%} {%- endblock -%}
